name: @footon/garmin
description: Bun-first ESM TypeScript client for Garmin Connect

scripts.build: rm -rf dist && bun build src/index.ts src/workouts/exercises.ts --outdir dist --target node --format esm && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && printf '{"type":"commonjs"}\n' > dist/types/package.json
scripts.check: bun run typecheck && bun run lint && bun run test
